title: Class 3 as a holographic projection or laser plasmoids

tellings.quote: And we are forced to ask yourself, and it's still only theory: isn't everything in holographic sky projection?

plain: Some of the strangest things seen in the sky may be projections, like holograms, or glowing balls of charged gas made by lasers, according to James Valor of Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call up UFOs and record them. Valor, who says he took part in the company's work between 2021 and 2025, offers this as an idea about a type of sighting the team calls Class 3, and he stresses it is "still only theory": "isn't everything in holographic sky projection?" If he is right, some of what people see up there may be a picture rather than a solid craft.
